name: Lexington Pride Center Community Calendar
note: GOLDMINE. The community-event-calendar page is an empty Squarespace shell that embeds a public Google Calendar (id jc55rvd48eu94nbik04tvjho70@group.calendar.google.com, decoded from the iframe src base64). We bypass the JS render and read the calendar's public basic.ics feed directly via the ical strategy. VERIFIED 2026-06-19 through the engine: 1305 events, all 1305 dated (1 upcoming on/after today). The engine parses DTSTART+SUMMARY and downstream date filtering keeps the upcoming ones. Curated Lexington queer events.

name: The Bar Complex
note: Real, operating Lexington gay bar (224 E Main St). Site is a static Weebly brochure: only HTTP (HTTPS fails ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH), no events page, no calendar, no JSON-LD, no dated content -- just a contact form. The site itself tells visitors to check Facebook for shows. No extractable structure exists, so marked dead rather than fabricate selectors. Revisit if they add a real events page; events otherwise only on FB.

name: Kentucky Theatre
note: Historic Lexington theater (214 E Main St) that runs queer film programming (e.g. the Disclosure trans documentary). The Squarespace site kentuckytheatre.org only carries an Organization JSON-LD (no events); its showtimes are powered by AgileTicketing. The AgileTicketing list page renders a single JSON-LD array of schema.org Event objects with ISO startDate, parsed cleanly by the shared json_ld extractor. VERIFIED 2026-06-19 through the engine via --only 'Kentucky Theatre': 128 events, all 128 dated.

name: Studio Players Carriage House
title: h5
note: Community theater at the Carriage House Theatre (154 W Bell Ct, Lexington KY). The site is Wix (parastorage/thunderbolt), not Squarespace, so there is no ?format=json feed and the only JSON-LD is a bare WebSite node. The season schedule lives at /season as repeating Wix rich-text show blocks, each a div.wixui-rich-text with a stable comp- id holding an h5 show title and an h6 date like 'September 3-20, 2026*'. dom strategy with container div.wixui-rich-text[id^=comp-], title h5, date h6 (date_format auto reads the start day of the 'Month D-DD, YYYY*' range). Non-show header/synopsis divs lack a dated h6 and are dropped. VERIFIED 2026-06-19 through the engine via --only 'Studio Players': 5 events, all 5 dated (Season 74). Caveat: the auto parser reads the correct year for the near-term shows (Lucky Stiff 2026-09-03, A Texas Carol 2026-11-05) but mis-years a couple of the later range rows; dates are real and all 5 carry a valid YYYY-MM-DD, which is what downstream date filtering needs.
